notes.title: [0.0.93] In-Game Wiki, and fun QOL changes!
notes.notes:
The new update brings a fun in-game wiki, entries in the in-game wiki are unlockable through defeating the enemies you are trying to look up!

QOL Changes:
[list]
[*] The player when logging in is now shown walking in the map they were last logged in at
[*] The loading screen is now set to show the map the player is entering
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] The leaderboard bug from 0.0.92 has been fixed
[/list]

notes.title: [V0.0.92] Leaderboard Optimization (No more lag!)
notes.notes:
The most laggy part of the game is now gone, with the new Leaderboard system, opening the leaderboard now only loads 50 players at a time, and can be scrolled through faster using the arrow keys.

This is something that has been needed due to the amount of people that have played, which is very motivating having this many players!

No longer shall we be oppressed by laggy leaderboards!

notes.title: V0.0.91 - Banks for 1500 players!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your ongoing support of the game and reaching 1500 players! 

V0.0.91 brings the following:

-fixed status enemies not being attackable
-fixed NPC glitch where they were hard to interact with
-Added Bank NPC, allows you to stack and store your items 

Best of RNG luck to all, & I hope everybody enjoys the new bank feature!

notes.title: 0.0.9 Update - New Area, Enemies, and Gear
notes.notes: This new area features new enemies that can drop new gear as well as a rarer more expensive version of that gear (very rare though)

notes.title: Leaderboard fixes and Witch bug fixed!
notes.notes:
Which bug? No, witch bug! The addition of the new Potion Witch NPC found to be creating some problems, which were thankfully minimized by this update!

(Note: There may still be issues, though nothing that breaks gameplay)

Special thanks to Coyote for that one!

Leaderboard fix:

Due to the pushing of the top 3 players (currently Dustry, FeminineEmenine, and Mystra), the leaderboards became more of a priority so I also included some updates to the leaderboard to make it a better place!  

(More info in Discord)

notes.title: Movement patch thoroughly tested and works!
notes.notes:
I apologize for the movement patch mishap, there seemed to be a bug that came with that patch that needed fixing, and after thorough testing you can now move while attacking enemies again!

Thank you to all the early access players that are contributing ideas and helpful feedback!

notes.title: Movement Fix
notes.notes: Movement patch that fixed player unable to move when attacking enemies

notes.title: 0.0.84a - Potion Witch NPC and Golem Balancing
notes.notes:
In this update, there is a new NPC in town, the Potion Witch and Golem

[b]Potion Witch[/b]
[list]
[*]allows you to purchase maximum potion upgrades that scale with your level, unlocked every 5 EXP levels gained.
[/list]

[b]Golem Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]After various feedback on the Golems attack and my own experience of being stuck at golems (fighting them while typing this), their attack has been decreased to 24.
[/list]

notes.title: Combat Fix
notes.notes: Enemies with less attack than your defense was causing issues previously

notes.title: Dragon Nerfed
notes.notes: The Dragon and Golem became OP in an earlier patch, this was fixed!

notes.title: Back-Up Saves Introduced!
notes.notes:
Thanks to one of our dedicated players having the delimma of almost losing their account, I helped them fix the situation, and then learned why it'd be good to have a back up save! So now you will have a backup save with instructions in the title, just delete the brackets and everything in them and you at least kept some progress!

This is the first case of this happening, so if anybody finds it happening to them, at least now there will be a back-up! (Though I will be actively working on the game to make sure these problems don't happen again)

notes.title: 0.0.8c
notes.notes:
Quick fix so the player doesn't have to zoom, set music volume, and set V-sync every time they play. 

Thank you for your patience during Early Access!
